description: Use this when the user asks about a recall of food, infant formula, a dietary supplement or a medicine, such as "was there a recall on this baby formula?" or "any supplement recalls this week?". Set category to "food" (human food, infant formula and supplements) or "drug". For pet food use search_pet_food_recalls instead. Pass the product words as labels use them ("infant formula", "peanut butter", "ibuprofen"). Set withinDays for recent recalls, such as 7 for this week. Returns FDA enforcement reports with product-title hits ranked above ingredient-text hits, each recall marked with matchKind ("product" or "text"), plus the recall class, product, reason, firm, lot codes and distribution. The matches count is the number of text matches across reports, not a product-recall total. It does not cover pet food, or meat, poultry and egg products regulated by USDA.

category.description: "food" covers human food, infant formula and dietary supplements (not pet food); "drug" covers medicines

limit.description: Most recalls to return, newest first (default 5)

query.description: Product words as on the label, such as "infant formula", "peanut butter" or "ibuprofen"

withinDays.description: Only recalls reported in the last this many days, such as 7 for this week

name: search_food_drug_recalls

matches.description: Count of matching enforcement reports in openFDA (includes text and ingredient matches, not a product-recall total)

matchKind.description: "product" when search terms appear in the product name or title; "text" when terms appear only in ingredients, allergen warnings or descriptions

title: Search food and drug recalls
